scope: One controlled training-label correction set derived from train/dev duplicate evidence; no dev or held-out label changes
model: Frozen Ticket 4 raw-text default TF-IDF plus balanced Logistic Regression, C=1.0, threshold=0.50
control: Original training labels and original dev labels
candidate: Eight proposed train-label corrections applied only to an in-memory copy; original dev labels unchanged
acceptance_rule: Adopt the corrected-training model only if every proposal confidence is at least 0.90, dev F1 is no worse than 0.002 below the frozen Ticket 4 dev F1, and the candidate fixes at least as many Ticket 4 dev errors as it creates. Otherwise retain the frozen Ticket 4 model. Held-out cannot affect this decision.

proposals.evidence: Raw-exact duplicate group contains IDs 4068 and 4077 labeled 1 in train and ID 4072 labeled 1 in dev; the text explicitly describes genocide, refugees, and internally displaced people.
Raw-exact train duplicates 6537 and 6548 are labeled 1; the text is a cleared traffic incident with injury, which is literal event reporting.
Raw-exact train duplicates 8702 and 8714 are labeled 0; 'sinking feeling' refers figuratively to discovering a phone used 3G, not a disaster.
Same raw-exact 3G-phone text as IDs 8698, 8702, and 8714; semantics are clearly figurative despite another canonical dev duplicate carrying label 1.
Raw-exact train duplicate 1922 is labeled 0; the text is a lyric-like phrase about 'burning buildings,' not a report of an event.
Raw-exact train duplicate 1950 is labeled 0; the speaker hypothetically wants burning buildings in a music video rather than reporting a disaster.
Four raw-exact duplicates (6087, 6090, 6111, 6118) are labeled 0; 'Hellfire' occurs in a religious charity quotation, not a literal fire.
Raw-exact dev duplicate 9470 is labeled 0; the text explicitly says Islam is the opposite of terrorism and reports no event.
